It's also worth noting that confidence is not just about how others perceive us, but also about how we perceive ourselves. When we feel good in what we're wearing, it can translate to other areas of our lives, such as our interactions with others, our body language, and even our overall attitude. So, keep rocking that dress and those high heels if they make you feel like the best version of yourself!
